member.name: T:Flux.Abstractions.ILanguageProfile
member.summary: Minimal language profile contract shared across the Flux ecosystem. Provides common language-specific text segmentation metadata.
member.remarks:
Each Flux module may extend this with module-specific members:
FileFlux: rich Regex-based members via ILanguageProfile in FileFlux.Core
FluxCurator: string-pattern-based members via ILanguageProfile in FluxCurator.Core
